notes.title: A.I. Space Corps goes Final Release
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that A.I. Space Corps completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/423180

A.I. Space Corps is a top-down space shooter taking place in the far future universe of A.I. Invasion. As the captain of a space ship it is your duty to defend bases, transmit intelligence through enemy sectors and reclaim occupied stations. Can you survive the dangers of outer space and fight back the merciless A.I.?

Full list of features

    3 different ships with distinct attributes
    flexible weapon upgrades throughout missions
    strategic gameplay through various board systems like secondary weapon or temporary shields
    different merciless enemy robots that have to be approached strategically
    various challenge missions and Steam leaderboards to compete on


The A.I. Space Corps Team

notes.title: A.I. Invasion - Road of Rodan is live!
notes.content:
The universe is scarred by the conflict between mankind and the merciless A.I. robots. But from every set back a hero is born who will lead his people through countless battles! 

"A.I. Invasion - Road of Rodan" tells the story of Recruit Rodan, the cheeky commander who helped you conquering the A.I. in the Rimae system. Find out how he grew to his present glory!

The Road of Rodan DLC brings various new missions and many new features to the battle against the merciless A.I.!
1 new campaign telling a prequel-story to the base game
4 new locations
4 new missions
a new special item
a unique and challenging boss fight

Get your A.I.-Fix now in Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/412900/


The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: Improvements and Additions
notes.content:
Over the past week various updates for A.I. Invasion solved many common issues and improved the game overall! We added language support for French, Italian and Spanish and the often requested Steam Trading Cards made it into the game!

Most important changes:
A.I. Invasion does now support French, Italian and Spanish language. The language can be set from the Steam client - within the games preferences.

Many missions were optimized to reduce stuttering and FPS drops. This is an ongoing process – expect more optimizations in close future!

1 new primary weapon and 2 new special items were added to the game. They are unlocked by beating certain missions. If you already completed the corresponding mission, the new equipment will be available right away.

Steam Trading Cards are now rewarded for playing the game.

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: A.I. Invasion goes gold!
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that A.I. Invasion completed its Early Access phase and is now available as full version! Many new features, missions and locations made it into the game.

Take on the role of a soldier fighting against the merciless A.I. machines controlling the universe. Traveling the Rimae planetary system you command a team that has to overcome various missions to defeat those pesky metal roaches. Utilize a wide range of weapons and even special items that aid you in battle! Can you reclaim the system from the A.I.?

Full list of features:
full story campaign telling the story of the reclamation of the Rimae planetary system
 20 varied missions with a wide range of objectives
 9 different environments on several planets and even in space
 6 unlockable main weapons with different shooting behaviors and projectile types
 5 unlockable special items, that serve as equippable special abilities
 control up to 5 special units to approach combat strategically
 full gamepad support
 Steam Achievements

Additionally many minor improvements, bugfixes and smaller feature additions mark the transition of A.I. Invasion from Early Access to full release. So, see you on the intergalactic battlefield!

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: The A.I. Invasion is growing!
notes.content:
A major update for A.I. Invasion was just released.
Thie update brings a new mission to the table and contains a new location to discover: The A.I. space station! Additionally, the game now fully supports gamepad control!
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/Steam_controller_banner600.png

In the mission players will leave solid ground behind and infiltrate an A.I. space station orbiting through the planetary system.
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/AI_Invasion_Spacestation1.jpg

This update also introduces various adjustments and features to the control system. First off, every aspect of the game con now be controlled with the gamepad. Furthermore, new radial menus can be opened in missions by holding a key or button. There is a radial menu for special unit selection and one for unit commands.
Keyboard default: Q / RMB
Gamepad default: RT / LT
The following image illustrates how the system works:
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/AI_Invasion_Radial_Menu610.jpg
Please note that due to these changes, mouse sensitivity might have changed. We added the option to adjust mouse sensitivity  to the keyboard options window.


Update detail

Features
the mission "Hot Proxies" was added to the game. The team infiltrates an A.I. space station to recover intelligence
full gamepad support was implemented
new radial menus are available to mouse/keyboard and gamepad control
mouse sensitivity can be adjusted in keyboard binding options

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: The A.I. Invasion universe is expanding!
notes.content:
A major update for A.I. Invasion was just released.
In 2 brand new missions the fight against the A.I. advances to the next level!

For the first time players will visit Duvoo, an A.I. infested desert planet, to retrieve cargo from a shot down A.I. flag ship. With an even bigger team players will then revisit the ice planet Alkonost to fend of the biggest A.I. army to date while retrieving valuable intelligence from the depths of the "frost fortress".
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/AI_Invasion_desert_map.jpg

Additionally the journey through the planetary system gets even more dangerous as 4 new A.I. enemy types are in production. The deadly "Suicide Bomber" for example is looking to blast his enemies and himself into orbit!
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/AI_Invasion_suicide_bomber.gif

To fend off the growing hordes of A.I. robots, a new special item made its way into the arsenal of mankind. The Shield Generator spans an area and blocks off all incoming projectiles while soldiers from inside can still shoot incoming foes.
http://www.ai-invasion.net/wp-content/uploads/AI_Invasion_shield_generator.jpg

Many more minor changes and bug fixes are contained within the update. 

Consult the full list for details:

Features
the Mission "Cargo Hunt" was added to the game. The team is fighting its way through a canyon on the new "Desert Planet" to retrieve cargo from a broken A.I. flag ship
the Mission "Snowball FX" was added to the game. This mission plays on Alkonost and requires the mission "Cold Base" to be completed
the special item "Shield Generator" was added to the game. The globe protects an area from incoming projectiles. It can be unlocked by completing the mission "Cargo Hunt"
4 new enemy types were added to various missions: Elite Levitant, Boss Levitant, Quick Flyer, Bomber

Changes
the user interface now shows more info and icons especially on the equipment screens, mission briefing and in missions
the weapons "Laser Rifle" and "Submachine Burst" were adjusted to be more even in terms of damage per second
radio transmissions from the commander are now centered

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: Hotfix 25/08
notes.content:
Hey guys,

you reported some bugs and we pushed another hotfix to get them out of the way! It just went live so check out what was changed or jump right into the action!

Changelog
the time it takes to change between weapon and special item was halved
the loading screen does now display default keyboard bindings
the HUD is now scaled based on display resolution
the HUD now shows which special unit is selected 
fixed an issue that led to severe audio distortion while shooting
resolved an issue with smaller enemies not attacking the transporter in the mission „Hiking Strike“
fixed undesired lighting flashes in the mission „Quarry Rock“

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: Hotfix 21/08
notes.content:
Hey guys,

a hotfix just went live that adresses more common issues around A.I. Invasion. Most notably:
the special item "healing station" does no longer heal enemies
the healing station is now properly disassembled when the player picks 
it up again
the navigation system was improved. Special units now have much less 
trouble when navigating stairs and bridges
dead special units can no longer talk
the pause menu does now properly lock the player character
the pause menu does now display the mission time in a proper format
changing between window mode and full screen in graphic options no 
longer breaks the user interface controls

Good luck on your travels through the contestes planetary system!

The A.I. Invasion Team

notes.title: A.I. Invasion enters Early Access!
notes.content:
A.I. Invasion just started into Early Access! Join the fight against the merciless machines and reclaim the planetary system for mankind! In 6 different missions you visit varied planets and even advanced underground complexes! Turn A.I. robots to scrap on the beautiful forest planet „Ceti VI“ or challenge them on the frosty ice planet „Alkonost“.

Even if you already discovered most of the current Early Access version, the fight is not over yet! Within the next weeks we will introduce new challenges but also features that will aid you on your journey! Stay tuned for:
new missions such as the hunt for cargo  from a destroyed ship in a desert battlefield
new special items such as the energy barrier, that allows you to shield off your team against enemy fire
an exclusive space taxi that will drop off your team into missions and might pick you up if you manage to survive! Have a quick look at it:
https://youtu.be/E8z9zD7tqno


Hotfix
We already received plenty of feedback and bug reports from you! As this announcement is posted a hotfix is already in place to adress the most common issues! See a list of changes:
improved ai navigation on the „Moon“ environment
enemy spawning and objective sequence of the mission „Orbiting“ was adjusted to prevent the player from skipping mission parts
the final objective of the mission „Quarry Rock“ does now spawn less enemies
the giant fourlegged A.I. Robot in the mission „Quarry Rock“ can now climb the north-western plateau
lowered the volume of Laser Shotgun shots
sound options do now save
keyboard bindings can now be changed after playing a mission
leaving a mission now opens the mission selection instead of the start menu

The A.I. Invasion Team
